land_notes: Coordinates are the Gogar settlement itself, recorded at settlement level only because no site for a distinct Gogar data centre could be evidenced. The two candidate schemes the reported 'Gogar' name likely refers to have precise sites in their own records: 1 Redheughs Avenue, South Gyle (Shelborn, ~1.5 km south-east of Gogarburn) and Wester Hermiston, Riccarton (Apatura, ~3 km south). The Gogar Special Landscape Area and Green Belt cover much of the surrounding land per City Plan 2030.
